name: Bridge rectifiers
summary: Four diodes in one block that turn AC into DC.
uses: Rectifying a transformer or wind generator output
Polarity protection on a DC input
Building a linear power supply or battery charger
identify: Square, flat or round blocks with four legs marked ~ ~ + −, on nearly every mains power supply board and in battery chargers and amplifiers. Big metal-cased ones (KBPC, 25–50A) sit on heatsinks in welders and chargers.
test: On diode mode each of the four diodes should read about 0.5–0.7V one way and open the other. A short in any direction means it’s dead.
